title: Audience policy fails open: persona_max_age dropped and unknown presence levels downgrade to None
description:
Two fail-open paths in the same policy parser. Neither is directly attacker-triggerable beyond what a caller can already request, but both silently weaken a stated policy instead of erroring - the wrong direction for a security parameter.

1. persona_max_age is parsed and then never used.
persona-core/src/audience.rs:62-66 parses it into AudienceExtensions::max_age_secs (audience.rs:25). Nothing in persona-grpc/src/service.rs ever reads ext.max_age_secs (confirmed: the only references to max_age_secs in the tree are audience.rs and its tests). A caller requesting
    https://rp.example?persona_max_age=60
gets a token with no freshness bound whatsoever and no indication the constraint was ignored. Meanwhile the Attestor::freshness() method (persona-attestors/src/lib.rs) exists and is never called from the issuance path either. CONSEQUENCE: a relying party that believes it has pinned a 60-second attestation-freshness window has pinned nothing; service.rs:160 hands it present_until = now + 300 regardless.

2. An unrecognised presence level silently becomes "no requirement".
persona-core/src/audience.rs:60-61:
    require_presence = PresenceLevel::from_str(val).unwrap_or(PresenceLevel::None);
PresenceLevel::from_str in persona-core/src/assurance.rs correctly returns AssuranceError::UnknownPresence for anything it does not know; unwrap_or throws that away and substitutes the WEAKEST level. So persona_require_presence=biometric, or a typo, or any level added in a future version of the spec, means "presence not required" rather than an error. The unit test at audience.rs:120-126 (unknown_presence_level_defaults_to_none) locks this behaviour in.

CONSEQUENCE for (2): version skew and typos silently disable the presence gate. A relying party publishes an audience string naming a level this build does not implement; an honest client passes it through verbatim; personad issues a token with presence.present=false (service.rs:167) that the RP believes carries the level it asked for. AudienceParseError already exists and is already returned for a bad persona_max_age (audience.rs:65) - a bad presence level should use the same path.

Fix direction: add AudienceParseError::UnknownPresence and propagate the from_str error; then either enforce max_age_secs against the attestors freshness() result or reject requests carrying it until it is implemented. Failing closed on an unimplemented policy parameter is the constraint that removes this whole class.
close_reason: Duplicate of persona-5s4b.71 (same defect, filed by a second review agent from a different angle). Merged during review triage; reopen if the angle in this issue is not covered there.
